name: street-photo-illustration
title_zh: 把街拍路人变成黑白墨线或彩色编辑风插画
tagline_zh: 照片里的人物一键转成干净插画，环境、姿势、穿搭、场景关系全保留。适合街拍、旅行、日常、商业空间照。
tagline_en: Turn people in your photos into clean ink or chibi-style illustrations, keeping the scene, pose, outfit, and.
desc_en: Transform people in uploaded street, travel, lifestyle, casual, or commercial-space photos into clean BLACK INK or colorful editorial-chibi illustrations while preserving the original photographic environment, pose, clothing, accessories, and scene relationships. Use when the user asks to illustrate, cartoonize, or create a photo-plus-character editorial treatment from real photos, with optional e
why_zh: 不只是换滤镜——它理解照片中的人物与环境关系，输出保留原始构图和细节的插画，而非粗暴的卡通化。
why_en: Not just a filter—it understands the person-scene relationship, preserving composition and details while delivering a true.
limit_zh: 仅处理人物主体，背景保持原样不重绘；需要上传真实照片，不支持纯文字描述生成；输出为插画风格，不保留照片质感。
limit_en: Only transforms people, not backgrounds; requires uploaded photos, not text prompts; output is illustration, not photo-real; complex multi-person.
